sections.title: Quick Take: Which LIC Term Insurance Plan Is Best for You?

content.text: For most buyers who want low cost + high trust, LIC New Tech-Term (Plan No. 954) is the best overall choice because of its competitive online-only premium. If you prefer in-person guidance for a high-value policy, consider the offline counterpart LIC New Jeevan Amar (Plan No. 955). For very small/simple needs, Saral Jeevan Bima is a good starter. I generally advise against Return-of-Premium (ROP) plans like Jeevan Kiran unless you prefer guaranteed return of paid premiums and accept significantly higher cost.

Get a free LIC term quote in 2 minutes — enter age & desired cover. No obligation.

We used live premium examples from market aggregators (PolicyBazaar, PolicyX) for common scenarios. This lic term insurance calculator helps you get an exact quote for your profile—premiums for a lic term insurance 1 crore policy differ widely by age and product.

sections.title: Which LIC Term Insurance Plans Exist? (Full Product List)

items.title: 1. LIC New Tech-Term — Plan No. 954 (UIN: 512N339V02)
items.text:
Type: Online-only, pure term (non-participating)
Key benefit: Lowest LIC premiums thanks to online rebate.
Eligibility: Age 18–65; policy term 10–40 years.
Best for: Self-directed, tech-savvy buyers who want cheapest pure protection from LIC.

items.title: 2. LIC New Jeevan Amar — Plan No. 955 (UIN: 512N338V02)
items.text:
Type: Offline equivalent of Tech-Term, sold via agents.
Key benefit: Agent support and servicing convenience.
Best for: Buyers who value face-to-face help for application & servicing.

items.title: 3. Saral Jeevan Bima — Plan No. 859 (UIN: 512N342V02)
items.text:
Type: Standardized pure-term product mandated by IRDAI for simplicity.
Key benefit: Simple features, accessible; usually covers up to ₹25 Lakh.
Best for: First-time buyers and low-cover needs.

items.title: 4. LIC Jeevan Kiran — Plan No. 870 (UIN: 512N359V02) — ROP
items.text:
Type: Return-of-Premium term plan.
Key benefit: All base premiums returned on survival (excl. taxes, rider premiums).
Best for: Highly risk-averse buyers who want a savings-like result — but be aware of the high cost.

items.title: 5. Bhagya Lakshmi — Plan No. 919 (UIN: 512N299V02)
items.text:
Type: Non-participating, limited payment protection for low-income households.
Best for: Rural / economically weaker segments.

items.title: 6. New Jeevan Mangal — Plan No. 940 (UIN: 512N308V02)
items.text:
Type: Micro-insurance with ROP element; protection + small savings.
Best for: Micro-insurance segment wanting a small savings component.

items.title: Note on Withdrawn Plans
items.text: Some legacy plans (e.g., Anmol Jeevan II) have been withdrawn or replaced; always check LIC’s product brochure for current availability.

sections.title: Key Features & Benefits of LIC Term Insurance

items: High Sum Assured: LIC term plans offer substantial coverage amounts, often going up to ₹1 crore and beyond, ensuring your family's financial needs are fully met.
Affordable Premiums: For a non-smoker, a high-value lic term insurance 1 crore policy can be secured for a very competitive monthly premium, especially when purchased online.
Flexible Payout Options: Nominees can choose to receive the death benefit as a lump sum, as a regular income, or a combination of both, providing flexibility to manage finances.
Rider Availability: You can enhance your protection by adding riders for accidental death, disability, or critical illness.
Tax Benefits: Premiums paid are eligible for tax deductions under Section 80C, and the death benefit payout to the nominee is tax-free under Section 10(10D).
Multiple Premium Payment Terms: Choose from Single, Regular, or Limited premium payment terms to align with your financial capacity.

sections.title: How LIC Term Premiums Are Calculated (Short & Practical)

content.text: Premiums are actuarial — they reflect the insurer’s assessment of risk. Main factors:

items: Smoker / tobacco use — smokers pay materially higher premiums.
Sum assured — higher cover increases premium linearly.
Policy term & PPT — longer terms and different paying terms affect cost.
Gender & health — underwriting can adjust prices based on gender and health disclosures.

content.text: Small changes (1–2 years of age, smoker → non-smoker) can change monthly premium noticeably — always pull an instant quote.

sections.title: Riders & Add-ons You Should Consider (and Those to Avoid)

content.text:
Worthwhile Add-ons:
  • Accidental Death & Disability Benefit Rider (AD&DB): Does the lic term plan cover accidental death? Yes, if you add this rider. It's a must-have.
  • Critical Illness Rider (CI): Provides a lump sum on diagnosis of major illnesses.
What to Avoid:
  • Return of Premium (ROP) Plans: Financially, it's often better to buy a cheaper pure term plan and invest the difference.
This is where LIC's reputation shines. The process to how to claim lic term insurance death claim is straightforward:

items: The nominee must intimate the claim by submitting the filled claim form along with the original death certificate and policy documents at the servicing branch.
LIC verifies the claim. Non-investigated claims must be settled within 30 days of receiving all documents.
LIC's Claim Settlement Ratio was 98.52% for FY2022-23.

items.q: What is the LIC Tech-Term Plan and how is it different?
items.a: LIC's New Tech-Term (Plan 954) is an online-only pure risk premium plan. It is different because it is cheaper than its offline counterpart, Jeevan Amar, as it offers a rebate for online sales, cutting out agent commissions. It is a popular choice for those looking to buy a simple lic term life insurance plan.

items.q: Can I buy LIC term insurance online?
items.a: Absolutely. LIC offers the 'New Tech-Term' plan specifically for online purchase. The process involves visiting LIC's official website, filling out the proposal form, uploading documents, and paying the first premium online.

items.q: How much premium for ₹1 Crore LIC term insurance for a 30-year-old non-smoker?
items.a: The premium for a lic term insurance 1 crore policy varies. Use our calculator for an exact quote, but a 30-year-old non-smoker can expect to pay approximately ₹1,000 - ₹1,500 per month for a Tech-Term plan.

items.q: Does LIC settle term claims reliably?
items.a: Yes. LIC has one of the highest Claim Settlement Ratios (CSR) in the industry, consistently above 98% (98.52% for FY 2022-23), indicating high reliability.
ROP plans return premiums on survival but cost much more. Financially, buying a cheap term plan and investing the difference usually gives higher returns.

content.text: Case Study 1: Raj, the Early Planner. Raj, a 28-year-old software engineer, bought a ₹1 Crore LIC term insurance plan until age 65. His premium was just ₹1,200/month. By buying early, he locked in a low rate for his entire working life.

Case Study 2: Sunita, the Late Starter. Sunita, a 45-year-old business owner, realized she was underinsured. She opted for a ₹1.5 Crore cover until age 70. Her premium was higher, around ₹4,500/month, but it gave her immense peace of mind.
LIC term insurance offers an unparalleled combination of trust and security. For most users, the LIC Tech-Term plan offers the best balance of low cost and high trust.
